description: This file defines the 'Details' feature for handling article details requests, including query validation and request handling logic for fetching an article by slug.

classes.name: Details.Query
classes.description: Represents the request for article details based on a slug.

classes.name: Details.QueryValidator
classes.description: Validates the query ensuring the slug is not null or empty.

classes.name: Details.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the incoming query to retrieve an article by slug, throws if not found.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Asynchronously handles the query to find and return an article, throws RestException if not found.
